title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 12 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We propose a 24-month fixed price without a surcharge clause, so your volume is secured for two full years and neither side carries index administration. The attached alternatives give you a choice on payment terms.

Is there a cheaper variant, for example in surface finish or bar length, that would suit you?

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, we also checked the index change data you cited where it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Additionally, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Our technical department will gladly investigate whether a cheaper variant in surface finish or bar length is feasible for your application. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We cannot offer a fixed price over 24 months, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause, but we can offer a unit price of €5.31 with 30 days payment. As an alternative, we offer a price of €5.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part:370010 – revised packages with longer commitment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter of 6 July notes that your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. We have therefore attached a 36-month option, giving you secured volume of 94800 kg per year for three years. Two packages are without a surcharge clause, so neither side carries index administration. The third keeps your clause with a 5% deadband. You can also choose the payment terms that suit your cash flow.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant, for example in bar length or tolerance, would work for you?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – revised packages with longer commitment
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our updated Angebot includes a price of €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We must retain the AS-14404 surcharge clause, as we cannot fix prices for 36 months, and our technical department is evaluating whether a different bar length or wider tolerance is feasible for your application. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a price of €5.26 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – revised packages with your AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your updated offer.

We have moved toward you on both points you raised. Both attached packages keep your AS-14404 surcharge clause with the 5% deadband, so cost movements after your fixed-price cover ends in March 2027 are passed through. Both run 36 months at 94800 kg per year, which gives your team a secured base for planning. You can choose 90 or 30 days payment, whichever suits your cash flow better.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

We would also welcome your technical department's view on a different bar length or wider tolerance once it is available.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised packages with your AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH! We appreciate your agreement to the 36-month contract term and the AS-14404 surcharge clause, which provides a solid foundation for our planning.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. In response to your movement on these terms, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.23 per unit for the 30-day payment option, alongside Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

Our technical department is currently evaluating the feasibility of a different bar length or wider tolerance for your application and will provide an update once the review is complete. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
